specification.objective: Show reviewable line-based difference between source snapshot and compaction proposal without changing memory.

requirements.statement: Return original ordered entries with the same fingerprint that was sent to the LLM.
Render a selectable, accessible Diff view of unchanged, removed and added lines for multiline and Unicode input.
Switching views or canceling never persists changes.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Return original ordered entries with the same fingerprint that was sent to the LLM. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.

Render a selectable, accessible Diff view of unchanged, removed and added lines for multiline and Unicode input. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.
Switching views or canceling never persists changes. Target-specific RED test must fail on unmodified baseline and pass after implementation.

invariants.statement: Do not change Hermes files, private method bindings, pending approval execution or compaction native application semantics; retain Magi 1.7.8.

forbidden_states.statement: Unapproved, stale or invalid edits are silently applied; LLM is invoked without explicit user opt-in outside compaction.

inputs.statement: Existing Hermes memory entries and Magi Desktop/backend plugin contracts.

outputs.statement: Documented, tested and reversible UX behavior; no direct native memory file writes.

failure_semantics.statement: On invalid source/remote failure preserve memory, preview and user draft; show actionable error.
